// Generator for go_types.json. To regenerate, copy into internal/domain as
// zz_rustfixture_test.go and run from the repo root:
//
//	RECUR_RUST_FIXTURE=$PWD/rust/crates/domain/tests/fixtures/go_types.json \
//	  go test ./internal/domain -run TestDumpRustFixture -count=1
//
// then delete the copy. Add new exported structs to the add(...) list and a
// matching line to tests/go_parity.rs.
package domain

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
	"reflect"
	"testing"
)

func rustFixtureFill(v reflect.Value, depth int, n *int, name string) {
	switch v.Kind() {
	case reflect.String:
		v.SetString(name + "<&>")
	case reflect.Int, reflect.Int64:
		*n++
		v.SetInt(int64(*n))
	case reflect.Float64:
		*n++
		v.SetFloat(float64(*n) + 0.5)
	case reflect.Bool:
		v.SetBool(true)
	case reflect.Slice:
		if v.Type() == reflect.TypeOf(json.RawMessage{}) {
			v.SetBytes([]byte(`{ "k": [1, "<x>"] }`))
			return
		}
		if depth > 3 {
			return
		}
		s := reflect.MakeSlice(v.Type(), 1, 1)
		rustFixtureFill(s.Index(0), depth+1, n, name+"0")
		v.Set(s)
	case reflect.Map:
		m := reflect.MakeMap(v.Type())
		k := reflect.New(v.Type().Key()).Elem()
		rustFixtureFill(k, depth+1, n, name+"K")
		val := reflect.New(v.Type().Elem()).Elem()
		rustFixtureFill(val, depth+1, n, name+"V")
		m.SetMapIndex(k, val)
		v.Set(m)
	case reflect.Ptr:
		if depth > 3 {
			return
		}
		p := reflect.New(v.Type().Elem())
		rustFixtureFill(p.Elem(), depth+1, n, name)
		v.Set(p)
	case reflect.Struct:
		for i := 0; i < v.NumField(); i++ {
			if v.Type().Field(i).IsExported() {
				rustFixtureFill(v.Field(i), depth+1, n, v.Type().Field(i).Name)
			}
		}
	}
}

func TestDumpRustFixture(t *testing.T) {
	path := os.Getenv("RECUR_RUST_FIXTURE")
	if path == "" {
		t.Skip()
	}
	out := map[string]map[string]string{}
	add := func(name string, zero any) {
		z, err := json.Marshal(zero)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(name, err)
		}
		full := reflect.New(reflect.TypeOf(zero))
		n := 0
		rustFixtureFill(full.Elem(), 0, &n, name)
		f, err := json.Marshal(full.Elem().Interface())
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(name, err)
		}
		out[name] = map[string]string{"zero": string(z), "full": string(f)}
	}
	add("Agent", Agent{})
	add("AgentSkill", AgentSkill{})
	add("AgentStep", AgentStep{})
	add("AgentSummary", AgentSummary{})
	add("AnalysisRun", AnalysisRun{})
	add("Artifact", Artifact{})
	add("AttentionCounts", AttentionCounts{})
	add("BranchChoice", BranchChoice{})
	add("BriefAction", BriefAction{})
	add("BriefingCounts", BriefingCounts{})
	add("BriefingSnapshot", BriefingSnapshot{})
	add("ChatAttachment", ChatAttachment{})
	add("ChatHeader", ChatHeader{})
	add("ChatImageRef", ChatImageRef{})
	add("ChatItem", ChatItem{})
	add("Check", Check{})
	add("Checkpoint", Checkpoint{})
	add("ChildFanOut", ChildFanOut{})
	add("Commit", Commit{})
	add("CompactPayload", CompactPayload{})
	add("CompatibleFlagDim", CompatibleFlagDim{})
	add("CompatibleFlagOption", CompatibleFlagOption{})
	add("CompatibleModel", CompatibleModel{})
	add("CompatibleProvider", CompatibleProvider{})
	add("ContentBlock", ContentBlock{})
	add("ConvPoint", ConvPoint{})
	add("ConversationLine", ConversationLine{})
	add("CopyFilesPreview", CopyFilesPreview{})
	add("DiffLine", DiffLine{})
	add("DiffStat", DiffStat{})
	add("DupClone", DupClone{})
	add("DupLoc", DupLoc{})
	add("Escalation", Escalation{})
	add("EscalationOption", EscalationOption{})
	add("FallbackPayload", FallbackPayload{})
	add("FeedItem", FeedItem{})
	add("FileContent", FileContent{})
	add("FileDiff", FileDiff{})
	add("FileDiffResult", FileDiffResult{})
	add("FileSearchHit", FileSearchHit{})
	add("FileSearchResult", FileSearchResult{})
	add("Finding", Finding{})
	add("FindingNote", FindingNote{})
	add("FocusNote", FocusNote{})
	add("Hotspot", Hotspot{})
	add("ImagePayload", ImagePayload{})
	add("ImpactItem", ImpactItem{})
	add("InboxItem", InboxItem{})
	add("IssueRef", IssueRef{})
	add("MCPServer", MCPServer{})
	add("Message", Message{})
	add("MetricDelta", MetricDelta{})
	add("MetricSnapshot", MetricSnapshot{})
	add("ModelRef", ModelRef{})
	add("OpenAsk", OpenAsk{})
	add("OpenInTarget", OpenInTarget{})
	add("OpenPathResult", OpenPathResult{})
	add("OutlineSymbol", OutlineSymbol{})
	add("PR", PR{})
	add("PRComment", PRComment{})
	add("PRParticipant", PRParticipant{})
	add("PRReaction", PRReaction{})
	add("PRReviewer", PRReviewer{})
	add("PRSummary", PRSummary{})
	add("PendingLineComment", PendingLineComment{})
	add("PermissionDecision", PermissionDecision{})
	add("PermissionRequest", PermissionRequest{})
	add("Plan", Plan{})
	add("PlanAttachment", PlanAttachment{})
	add("PlanStep", PlanStep{})
	add("Policy", Policy{})
	add("PresentWorkspaceResult", PresentWorkspaceResult{})
	add("Project", Project{})
	add("ProjectGroup", ProjectGroup{})
	add("Rail", Rail{})
	add("ReplaceResult", ReplaceResult{})
	add("Resource", Resource{})
	add("RunCommand", RunCommand{})
	add("ScheduledPrompt", ScheduledPrompt{})
	add("ScheduledPromptRun", ScheduledPromptRun{})
	add("SearchHit", SearchHit{})
	add("SearchOpts", SearchOpts{})
	add("SearchResult", SearchResult{})
	add("Session", Session{})
	add("SessionContext", SessionContext{})
	add("SessionView", SessionView{})
	add("Settings", Settings{})
	add("StoredEvent", StoredEvent{})
	add("SummaryPara", SummaryPara{})
	add("SymbolDef", SymbolDef{})
	add("SymbolRef", SymbolRef{})
	add("TestResult", TestResult{})
	add("TextPayload", TextPayload{})
	add("ThinkingPayload", ThinkingPayload{})
	add("ToolResultPayload", ToolResultPayload{})
	add("ToolUsePayload", ToolUsePayload{})
	add("TreeEntry", TreeEntry{})
	add("UpdateWorkspaceResult", UpdateWorkspaceResult{})
	add("UserQuestion", UserQuestion{})
	add("UserQuestionAnswer", UserQuestionAnswer{})
	add("VerifyStep", VerifyStep{})
	add("Workspace", Workspace{})
	add("WorkspaceBrief", WorkspaceBrief{})
	add("WorkspaceChatTab", WorkspaceChatTab{})
	add("WorkspaceContext", WorkspaceContext{})
	add("WorkspaceLandState", WorkspaceLandState{})
	add("WorktreeCommitResult", WorktreeCommitResult{})
	b, err := json.MarshalIndent(out, "", "  ")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(path, append(b, '\n'), 0o644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}
